newsitem.title: USA: Starrett to be acquired for $12.25 per shr.
newsitem.headline: Starrett to be acquired for $12.25 per shr.

text.p: Starrett Corp said Wednesday it entered a definitive agreement to merge with entities controlled by Jacob Frydman for a cash payment of $12.25 per share.
Starrett said in a statement that it expected to submit the proposal to shareholders within the next 60 to 90 days.
The construction company also said holders of roughly 52 percent of the company's outstanding shares agreed to vote in favor of the merger.
Jacob Frydman is president of Frydman & Co, a real estate merchant bank.
